gaps.explanation: All seven governmental fund columns of the GAAP Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp8, 10) have a schedule in detail[], but the schedules are the Budget and Actual (Budget Basis) schedules (pp15-21). GAAP total revenues by fund (pp8, 10): General 25,662,153, Debt Service 4,924,145, Keno 1,357,071, Capital Improvements 68,772, Economic Development 254,207, 84th Street Redevelopment 3,872,461, Police Academy 206,827 = 36,345,636. Budget-basis printed totals: General 24,090,729 (p15), Keno 1,322,194 (p16), Police Academy 198,821 (p17), Debt Service 4,134,479 (p18), Capital Improvement 68,773 (p19), Economic Development 250,674 (p20), 84th Street 3,075,514 (p21) = 33,141,184; basis difference 36,345,636 - 33,141,184 = 3,204,452 (e.g. sales taxes 3,431,486 GAAP vs 2,634,539 budget in both Debt Service and 84th Street). The other 198,328: the Economic Development Program Fund budget schedule (p20) prints actual revenue lines Other Income 6,272 + Interest income 46,074 = 52,346 but Total revenues 250,674 (the report itself does not add up; no printed row carries the 198,328, so nothing can be added). 3,204,452 + 198,328 = 3,402,780 = gap. No fix.

GAAP total expenditures by fund (pp9, 11): General 22,747,910, Debt Service 4,923,459, Keno 723,260, Capital Improvements 10,957,624, Economic Development 4,149,936, 84th Street 18,490,013, Police Academy 202,571 = 62,194,773. Budget-basis schedule lines (pp15-21): General 22,187,143 (printed total 22,187,142), Keno 689,643, Police Academy 199,890, Debt Service 4,630,142, Capital Improvement 11,484,914 (printed total 11,484,915), Economic Development 6,162,354, 84th Street 17,045,014 = 62,399,100. Schedule is 204,327 above the statement purely from the budget vs GAAP basis (e.g. Economic Development 6,162,354 budget vs 4,149,936 GAAP; 84th Street 17,045,014 vs 18,490,013). No fix.

Statement Total Governmental Funds column prints Transfers, net (700) (p11). Detail records transfers gross per fund from the budget schedules: General (961,581) p15, Keno (487,640) p16, Debt Service (3,234,649) p18 = 4,683,870 out; Capital Improvement +3,648,489 p19 and Economic Development +1,034,681 p20 = 4,683,170 in; net (700) = statement. (GAAP fund columns p9: General (1,494,856), Capital Improvements 4,181,764; the other funds equal the budget schedules; also net (700).) Gross-vs-net only. No fix.
